title: Migrating to TypeScript
description: Strategies for migrating existing React projects to TypeScript incrementally.

data.text: Migrating a React codebase to TypeScript can be done incrementally without rewriting the entire application.

items: Start with .tsx extension for React components
Gradually replace any with proper types
Use allowJs and checkJs in tsconfig

data.title: Incremental Migration
Common Pitfalls
data.text: Don't enable strict mode immediately. Start with loose checks and tighten gradually to avoid overwhelming your team.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Migrate incrementally, not all at once
Use any as a temporary placeholder
data.takeaway: A gradual migration minimizes disruption while gaining TypeScript benefits.
